results.name: camera-dolly-zoom
results.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
results.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

results.name: hw-write-title

results.name: gooey-split
results.title: Gooey Split
results.description: A dot splits into a three-dot menu with a gooey metaball neck, spins into a swirl mark under directional shutter motion blur, then breaks back into three dots and merges into one. The goo is an SVG blur-and-threshold filter on the dots; the blur integrates each part along its real trajectory, so the smear follows the direction and speed of the spin.

results.name: motion-blur
results.title: Motion Blur

results.name: grade-split-reveal

Both looks are real HyperFrames color grading run through the WebGL shader, so the preview and the render match.

results.name: spiral-galaxy

results.name: chat-message

results.name: whip-pan-cut
